ios.build: xcodegen generate --spec project.yml && xcodebuild -project CanvasFixedTextEvidence.xcodeproj -scheme CanvasFixedTextEvidence -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -jobs 2
ios.readiness: exact LUNA_FIXED_TEXT_READY and LUNA_FIXED_TEXT_ROOT case+nonce receipts
ios.stability: two consecutive screenshots with equal lowercase SHA-256 plus rehash after crop

android.launch: adb -s emulator-5554 shell am start -n com.penkra.canvas.fixture/.MainActivity --es canvasCase <CASE_ID> --es canvasNonce <NONCE>
android.settings: adb -s emulator-5554 shell wm density <320|420>; adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings put system font_scale <1|2>
android.stability: two consecutive screenshots with equal lowercase SHA-256

comparator.classifications: typography, decorations, and line-wrapping are reported separately
comparator.verdict: unmeasured until native receipt, stable frames, and comparison exist
